The Majesty 120 has earned global recognition for its striking design, advanced engineering and rare six-cabin layout

Press Release

The latest Majesty 120 has entered the water at the UAE shipyard, marking another milestone for one of the brand's most successful superyacht models. Since its global debut in 2020, the Majesty 120 has earned global recognition for its striking design, advanced engineering and rare six-cabin layout, becoming a favourite among owners seeking a yacht equally suited to private cruising and luxury charter. 

Recognition at the BOAT International Design & Innovation Awards, where the Majesty 120 received both the Eco Award and Best Naval Architecture, has further reinforced the yacht's reputation as one of the most accomplished superyachts in her class. 

Designed for extended time on board, the Majesty 120 offers expansive living across three beautifully appointed decks, where every space has been created to maximise comfort, privacy and entertaining. Her sculpted proPile, distinguished by sleek angular lines, signature Majesty glazing and elegant glass railings, creates a seamless visual connection between the yacht's luxurious interiors and the surrounding seascape. 

Beyond her luxurious living spaces, this model is famous for advanced engineering throughout. Commercial-grade navigation, automation and water treatment systems, together with advanced noise insulation and intuitive onboard technology, ensure every voyage is dePined by comfort, efPiciency and reliability. 

As this newest hull joins the water, the Majesty 120 continues to demonstrate brand’s ability to deliver superyachts that stand conPidently alongside the world's most respected shipyards. 

About Majesty 

Majesty is the award-winning yacht and superyacht brand offering an impressive 9leet from the Majesty 60 up to the 9lagship Majesty 175 – the largest composite superyacht today. 

Every Majesty is designed, engineered and handcrafted in the United Arab Emirates. A multinational in- house design team supported by renowned external naval architects and designers from the Netherlands, Italy, UK, South-Africa and Australia works alongside Majesty’s artisans and engineers to blend advanced technologies with meticulous 9inishing quality. The result is a portfolio of graceful yachts that offers owners semi-custom 9lexibility, unwavering build quality and class-approved safety. 

The Majesty Yacht Collection, starting at 60ft, introduces yacht owners to the brand’s hallmark characteristics of smart layouts and space utilisation, seamless indoor-outdoor living and excellent sea- 

keeping, while the Superyacht Collection (100–175ft) elevates those principles to ocean-going grandeur. Across the range, an eye for elegant detail and sublime comfort immerse guests in a ‘Life of Excellence’.
